translations.web: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
translations.bsb: However, if the servant gets up after a day or two, the owner shall not be punished, since the servant is his property.
translations.kjv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
translations.asv: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
